name: سكريبت يطلع القرش عند الاهلي.sql
content:
SELECT E.GRANDTOTAL, F.AMTACCTDR, F.RECORD_ID, E.DATEINVOICED, E.DOCUMENTNO
  FROM c_invoice e
       JOIN (SELECT SUM(t.AMTACCTDR) AMTACCTDR, t.RECORD_ID
               FROM fact_aCCT t WHERE T.AD_TABLE_ID = 318
             GROUP BY t.RECORD_ID) F ON F.RECORD_ID = E.C_INVOICE_ID
 WHERE e.isSotrx = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(e.dateinvoiced, 'yyyy') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy')
       AND e.c_pos_id IS NOT NULL AND E.GRANDTOTAL <> F.AMTACCTDR;

name: 01- view to fix currncy Revalation.sql
content:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW FACT_ACCT_CURR_REVAL_V AS
SELECT fa.*, fa.amtacctdr - fa.amtacctcr balance, c.stdprecision
FROM fact_acct fa
INNER JOIN c_currency c ON c.c_currency_id = fa.c_currency_id
WHERE fa.c_currency_id <> fa.currencyrate_acct AND fa.amtsourcecr + fa.amtsourcedr <> 0
AND (fa.amtacctdr <> 0 OR fa.amtacctcr <> 0);

name: C_POSRETURNORDER_V (1).sql
content:
DROP VIEW C_POSRETURNORDER_V;

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW C_POSRETURNORDER_V AS
SELECT o.C_ORDER_ID, o.DOCUMENTNO, o.DATEORDERED, o.C_BPARTNER_ID, o.GRANDTOTAL,
       ol.C_ORDERLINE_ID, ol.M_PRODUCT_ID, ol.QTYORDERED, ol.PRICEACTUAL
FROM C_ORDER o
INNER JOIN C_ORDERLINE ol ON ol.C_ORDER_ID = o.C_ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ISRETURN = 'Y' AND o.DOCSTATUS IN ('CO','CL');

name: DW_SALESINVOICE.sql
content:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW DW_SALESINVOICE AS
SELECT i.C_INVOICE_ID, i.DOCUMENTNO, i.DATEINVOICED, i.C_BPARTNER_ID,
       bp.NAME bpartner_name, i.GRANDTOTAL, i.TOTALLINES,
       i.C_CURRENCY_ID, i.SALESREP_ID, u.NAME salesrep_name,
       i.AD_ORG_ID, org.NAME org_name
FROM C_INVOICE i
LEFT JOIN C_BPARTNER bp ON bp.C_BPARTNER_ID = i.C_BPARTNER_ID
LEFT JOIN AD_USER u ON u.AD_USER_ID = i.SALESREP_ID
LEFT JOIN AD_ORG org ON org.AD_ORG_ID = i.AD_ORG_ID
WHERE i.ISSOTRX = 'Y' AND i.DOCSTATUS IN ('CO','CL');

name: PP_RESOURCEASSIGNMENT_OPEN_V.sql
content:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW PP_RESOURCEASSIGNMENT_OPEN_V AS
SELECT A.S_RESOURCEASSIGNMENT_ID, A.AD_CLIENT_ID, A.PP_ORDER_ID,
       A.PP_ORDER_NODE_ID, A.S_RESOURCE_ID, A.QTY, A.ASSIGNDATEFROM, A.ASSIGNDATETO,
       S.DATE1, A.ASSIGNDATEFROM SHIFTDATEFROM, A.ASSIGNDATETO SHIFTDATETO, N.DURATIONUNIT
FROM S_RESOURCEASSIGNMENT A
INNER JOIN PP_ORDER_NODE N ON N.PP_ORDER_NODE_ID = A.PP_ORDER_NODE_ID
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT S.S_RESOURCE_ID, DATE1 FROM PP_CALENDARSHIFT_V V
            INNER JOIN S_RESOURCE S ON V.PP_CALENDAR_ID = S.PP_CALENDAR_ID) S
  ON S.S_RESOURCE_ID = A.S_RESOURCE_ID
WHERE A.QTY > 0;

name: RV_PAYMENT.sql
content:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW RV_PAYMENT AS
SELECT p.C_PAYMENT_ID, p.DOCUMENTNO, p.DATETRX, p.C_BPARTNER_ID,
       bp.NAME bpartner_name, p.PAYAMT, p.C_CURRENCY_ID, p.ISRECEIPT,
       p.DOCSTATUS, p.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID, ba.NAME bankaccount_name
FROM C_PAYMENT p
LEFT JOIN C_BPARTNER bp ON bp.C_BPARTNER_ID = p.C_BPARTNER_ID
LEFT JOIN C_BANKACCOUNT ba ON ba.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID = p.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID;

name: TerminationPrint_RV (1).sql
content:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW TerminationPrint_RV AS
SELECT e.HR_Employee_ID, e.NAME employee_name, e.JOININGDATE,
       t.HR_TERMINATION_ID, t.TERMINATIONDATE, t.REASON,
       e.C_BPARTNER_ID, bp.NAME bpartner_name
FROM HR_Employee e
INNER JOIN HR_TERMINATION t ON t.HR_Employee_ID = e.HR_Employee_ID
LEFT JOIN C_BPARTNER bp ON bp.C_BPARTNER_ID = e.C_BPARTNER_ID;

name: VIEW-EDIT-OPEN-BALANCE-OF-BANK-C_BANKACCOUNT_V.sql
content:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW C_BANKACCOUNT_V AS
SELECT ba.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID, ba.NAME, ba.CURRENTBALANCE, ba.C_CURRENCY_ID,
       c.ISO_CODE currency_code,
       (SELECT SUM(p.PAYAMT) FROM C_PAYMENT p WHERE p.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID = ba.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID AND p.DOCSTATUS IN ('CO','CL') AND p.ISRECEIPT = 'Y') total_receipts,
       (SELECT SUM(p.PAYAMT) FROM C_PAYMENT p WHERE p.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID = ba.C_BANKACCOUNT_ID AND p.DOCSTATUS IN ('CO','CL') AND p.ISRECEIPT = 'N') total_payments
FROM C_BANKACCOUNT ba
LEFT JOIN C_CURRENCY c ON c.C_CURRENCY_ID = ba.C_CURRENCY_ID;

name: VIEW-IMPORT-PO-C_ORDER-IN-PURCHASE-INVOICE-C_INVOICE-C_PI_PO_CF_V.sql
content:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW C_PI_PO_CF_V AS
SELECT i.C_INVOICE_ID, i.DOCUMENTNO invoice_no, i.DATEINVOICED,
       o.C_ORDER_ID, o.DOCUMENTNO po_no, o.DATEORDERED,
       i.C_BPARTNER_ID, bp.NAME bpartner_name,
       il.M_PRODUCT_ID, p.NAME product_name,
       il.QTYINVOICED, il.PRICEACTUAL, il.LINENETAMT
FROM C_INVOICE i
INNER JOIN C_INVOICELINE il ON il.C_INVOICE_ID = i.C_INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN C_ORDER o ON o.C_ORDER_ID = il.C_ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN C_BPARTNER bp ON bp.C_BPARTNER_ID = i.C_BPARTNER_ID
LEFT JOIN M_PRODUCT p ON p.M_PRODUCT_ID = il.M_PRODUCT_ID
WHERE i.ISSOTRX = 'N' AND i.DOCSTATUS IN ('CO','CL');

name: WAREHOUSEMOVEMENT_RV.sql
content:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW WAREHOUSEMOVEMENT_RV AS
SELECT m.M_MOVEMENT_ID, m.DOCUMENTNO, m.MOVEMENTDATE, m.DOCSTATUS,
       ml.M_MOVEMENTLINE_ID, ml.M_PRODUCT_ID, p.NAME product_name,
       ml.MOVEMENTQTY, ml.M_LOCATOR_ID, ml.M_LOCATORTO_ID,
       l.VALUE from_locator, lt.VALUE to_locator
FROM M_MOVEMENT m
INNER JOIN M_MOVEMENTLINE ml ON ml.M_MOVEMENT_ID = m.M_MOVEMENT_ID
LEFT JOIN M_PRODUCT p ON p.M_PRODUCT_ID = ml.M_PRODUCT_ID
LEFT JOIN M_LOCATOR l ON l.M_LOCATOR_ID = ml.M_LOCATOR_ID
LEFT JOIN M_LOCATOR lt ON lt.M_LOCATOR_ID = ml.M_LOCATORTO_ID;

name: WF_Error.sql
content:
SELECT a.AD_WF_ACTIVITY_ID, a.WFSTATE, a.TEXTMSG, a.AD_TABLE_ID,
       a.RECORD_ID, t.TABLENAME, a.CREATED, a.UPDATED
FROM AD_WF_ACTIVITY a
INNER JOIN AD_TABLE t ON t.AD_TABLE_ID = a.AD_TABLE_ID
WHERE a.WFSTATE IN ('ST','HA') AND a.TEXTMSG IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.CREATED DESC;

name: SQL STATTMENT WITH SESSION  NO.
description: Get SQL statement for a specific Oracle session
content:
SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.status, q.sql_text
FROM v$session s
JOIN v$sql q ON s.sql_id = q.sql_id
WHERE s.sid = :session_no;
